title: A2M Thr654Cys Thr661Cys mutant disulfide mapping
projectDescription: The Thr654Cys and Thr661Cys mutations were used to introduce a disulfide bridge into the interacting LNK domains of human A2M. In this study, formation of the disulfide was investigated by mass spectrometry.
sampleProcessingProtocol: The A2M mutant was directly digested (no reduction or alkylation) by pepsin by acidification with 1% FA, addition of 1:20 w/w pepsin, and overnight digestion at 37 degrees.   Alternatively, the A2M mutant was alkylated with 10 mM IAA for 30 minutes at RT with 6 M urea, after which the proteins were desalted using Zebra spin columns into 0.2 M histidine, pH6. Trypsin, chymotrypsin, or both proteases were added to a 1:20 w/w ratio and sample was digested O/N at 37 degrees. LC-MS/MS peptide analysis was performed using online reverse phase separation of peptides on an EASY-nLC 1200 (Thermo Fisher Scientific) over a homemade C18 column and an Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) running a DDA method.
dataProcessingProtocol: Data were searched with Protein Metrics Byonic software.
